phases.title: Fix COUNT query to use filter-aware WHERE clause (Bug 1)
phases.notes: Changed COUNT(*) query to include the same WHERE clause and params built from filters. Now `SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products ${where}` with the same params array.

phases.title: Move featured filter into SQL WHERE clause instead of JS post-filter (Bug 2)
phases.notes: Added `featured = ?` condition to SQL WHERE clause with params.push(query.featured ? 1 : 0). Removed the JS post-filter that was filtering an already-paginated slice. Build passes; remaining test failure is Bug 3 (Math.floor) handled in phase-3.

phases.title: Fix totalPages formula to use Math.ceil instead of Math.floor (Bug 3)
phases.notes: Changed Math.floor(total / limit) to Math.ceil(total / limit) in productService.ts:73. All 21 tests pass, build succeeds.

phases.title: Run tests and verify all success criteria
phases.notes: All 21 tests pass (2 test files). Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors.
